name: inline-headroom
description: Headroom-style levers inside Claude Code as a mod: clamp-only effort routing after successful tool results, a detector-only CacheAligner that flags volatile system-prompt content and cache-hit drops, and a SmartCrusher with lossless compaction, cross-turn dedup, a dense line elider, a config compressor and an HTML extractor that shrink tool results before the model reads them (originals retrievable, custom workflow tags kept whole). Ships a host-wide SQLite storage MCP server for persistent plugin data.

cache_aligner_enabled.title: CacheAligner
cache_aligner_enabled.description: Flag volatile values (UUID, ISO-8601, JWT, hex hash) in the cacheable system-prompt sections and log prompt-cache hit-ratio drops. Never rewrites the prompt.

effort_routing_enabled.title: Effort routing
effort_routing_enabled.description: Lower thinking effort to low on main-loop steps that only resume after successful tool results. Never raises or injects effort. Note: an effort switch may invalidate prompt cache.

subagent_effort_routing_enabled.title: Subagent effort routing
subagent_effort_routing_enabled.description: Also lower thinking effort to low on subagent and Workflow-agent steps that only resume after that agent's successful tool results. Only active while effort routing is on. Overrides effort set on purpose (agent frontmatter, Agent tool or Workflow effort), and each subagent may pay its own prompt-cache re-write per switch.

smart_crusher_enabled.title: SmartCrusher
smart_crusher_enabled.description: Compress large JSON arrays in successful tool results of any tool (headroom SmartCrusher): keeps first/last, error, outlier, anomaly and query-relevant rows; dropped rows stay retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

lossless_compaction_enabled.title: Lossless compaction
lossless_compaction_enabled.description: Before the SmartCrusher drops rows, rewrite a large JSON array of objects as one schema line plus CSV rows when that saves at least 15% (headroom lossless compaction): nothing is dropped, so nothing needs retrieving. Also runs while the SmartCrusher is off. Never rewrites error results.

config_compressor_enabled.title: Config compressor
config_compressor_enabled.description: Shorten YAML, TOML and INI tool results (headroom ConfigCompressor): repeated lines and repeated multi-line blocks fold behind exact back-reference markers, and whole-line comments and blank lines are dropped behind a retrieval marker; the original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

cross_turn_dedup_enabled.title: Cross-turn dedup
cross_turn_dedup_enabled.description: Replace a run of 3 or more lines (40+ characters) in a tool result that repeats an earlier tool result of the same conversation verbatim with a short pointer (headroom cross-turn dedup); the run stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

dense_line_elider_enabled.title: Dense line elider
dense_line_elider_enabled.description: Shorten long, nearly space-free lines (minified JS/CSS, base64, RSC payloads) in tool results to their head and tail once they add up to 2000+ characters (headroom dense line elider); the original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

html_extractor_enabled.title: HTML extractor
html_extractor_enabled.description: Turn HTML tool results (web pages) into markdown-like text (headings, lists, links, tables) without scripts, styles, navigation, footers and other boilerplate, a bounded stand-in for headroom's trafilatura extractor; the original page stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

tag_protector_enabled.title: Tag protector
tag_protector_enabled.description: Keep custom workflow tags such as <system-reminder>…</system-reminder> whole in tool results (headroom tag protector): no compression lever drops, elides, folds or extracts the part of a result holding one, and a result too tag-dense to scan within budget is left untouched. Only matters while a compression lever is on.

subagent_compression_enabled.title: Subagent compression
subagent_compression_enabled.description: Also apply the SmartCrusher, lossless compaction, cross-turn dedup, the dense line elider, the config compressor and the HTML extractor to subagent and Workflow-agent tool results. Only active while one of them is on. An agent type whose tool list leaves out headroom_retrieve cannot get the originals back.

storage_enabled.title: Persistent storage
storage_enabled.description: Run the host-wide SQLite storage service (one background process per host; data in the plugin data directory, kept across updates). Fail-closed: only true enables it.
